text.body: yatīndramatadīpikā atha prathamo'vatāraḥ maṅgalācaraṇam śrīveṅkaṭeśaṃ kariśailanāthaṃ śrīdevarājaṃ ghaṭikādrisiṃham| kṛṣṇena sākaṃ yatirājamīḍe svapne ca dṛṣṭānmama deśikendrān||1|| yatīśvaraṃ praṇamyāhaṃ vedāntārya mahāgurum| karomi bālabodhārthaṃ yatīndramatadīpikām||2|| tattvaikyasya pratijñā śrīmannārāyaṇa eva cidacidviśiṣṭo'dvaitaṃ tattvam, bhaktiprapattibhyāṃ prasannassa evopāyaḥ, aprākṛtadeśaviśiṣṭassa eva prāpyaḥ iti vedāntavākyaiḥ pratipādayatāṃ vyāsabodhayanaguhadevabhārūcibrahmanandidramiḍācāryaśrīparāṅkuśanāthayāmunamuniyatīśrvaraprabhṛtīnāṃ matānusāreṇa bālabodhanārtha vedāntānusāriṇī yatīndramatadīpikākhyā śārīrakaparibhāṣā mahācāryakṛpāvalambinā mayā yathāmati saṅgraheṇa prakāśyate| padārthasamuddeśaḥ sarvaṃ padārthajātaṃ pramāṇaprameyabhedena dvidhā bhinnam| pramāṇāni trīṇyeva| prameyaṃ dvividham - dravyādravyabhedāt| dravyaṃ dvividham - jaḍamajaḍaṃ ceti| jaḍaṃ ca dvividham - prakṛtiḥ kālaśceti| prakṛtiścatuviṃśatitattvātmikā|kālastu upādhibhedena trividhaḥ| ajaḍaṃ tu dvividham - parāk pratyak ceti| parāgapi dvidhā - nityabhūtiḥ dharmabhūtajñānaṃ ceti| pratyagapi dvividhaḥ jīveśvara bhedāt|jīvastrividhaḥ - baddhamuktanityabhedāt| baddho'pi dvividhaḥ - bubhukṣu mumukṣubhedāt| bubhukṣurdvividha - arthakāmaparo dharmaparaśceti| dharmaparo dvividhaḥ - devatāntaraparo bhagavatparaśceti| mumukṣurdvividhaḥ - kaivalyaparo mokṣaparaśceti| mokṣaparo dvividhaḥ - bhaktaḥ prapannaśceti| prapannaśca dvividhaḥ ekāntī paramaikāntī ceti| paramaikāntī dvividhaḥ - dṛptārtabhedāt| īśvaraḥ pañdhā - paravyūhavibhavāntaryāmyarcāvatārabhedāt|para ekadhā| vyūhaścaturdhā - vāsudevasaṅkarṣaṇapradyumnānirūddhabhedāt| keśavādi vyūhāntaramatraivāntarbhavati| matsyādayo vibhavāḥ punaranantā| antaryāmī pratiśarīramavasthitaḥ| arcāvatārastu śrīraṅgaveṅkaṭādrihastigiriyādavādrighaṭikācalādiṣu sakalamanuja nayanaviṣayatāṃ gato mūrtiviśeṣaḥ| adravyaṃ tu sattvarajastamaśaśbadasparśarūparasagandhasaṃyogaśaktibhedāddaśadhaiva| uddiṣṭapadārthānāṃ lakṣaṇaparīkṣāyāḥ pratijñā evamuddiṣṭānāmuddeśakrameṇa lakṣaṇaparīkṣe kriyete| pramāṇalakṣaṇam tatra - pramākaraṇaṃ pramāṇam| pramāṇaṃ lakṣyam| pramākaraṇatvaṃ lakṣaṇam| pramālakṣaṇam yathāvasthitavyavahārānuguṇaṃ jñānaṃ pramā| pramā lakṣyam| yathāvasthitavyavahārānuguṇajñānatvaṃ lakṣaṇam| jñānaṃ prametyukte śuktikāyāmidaṃ rajatamiti jñāne'tivyāptiḥ| ata uktaṃ vyavahārānuguṇamiti| evamapi tatraivātivyāptiḥ - bhrāntidaśāyāmidaṃ rajatamiti vyavahniyamāṇatvāt| ata uktaṃ yathāvasthiteti| yathāvasthitapadena saṃśayānyathājñānaviparītajñānavyāvṛttiḥ| viśiṣṭe (dharmiṇi) sthāṇurvā puruṣo veti jñānam| anyathājñānaṃ nāma dharmaviparyāsaḥ| yathā - kṛrtṛtvena bhāsamāne ātmani kuyuktibhiḥ kartṛtvasya bhrāntatvopapādanam| viparītajñānaṃ nāma dharmiviparyāsaḥ| yathā - vastuno vastvantarajñānam| lakṣaṇasya doṣatrayam lakṣaṇasya trīṇi dūṣaṇāni santi - avyāptirativyāptirasambhavaśceti| lakṣyaikadeśe lakṣaṇasyāvartanamavyāptiḥ| lakṣyādanyatra vartamānatvamativyāptiḥ| lakṣye kvāpyavartanamasambhavaḥ| yathā - jīvo guṇatrayavaśyaḥ ityukte avyāptiḥ| jñānaguṇaka ityukte ativyāptiḥ, cakṣurviṣayo jīva ityukte'sambhava eva| atroktadūṣaṇatrayābhāvāt pramālakṣaṇaṃ sustham| karaṇapadārthavivecanam sādhakatamaṃ karaṇam| atiśayitaṃ sādhakaṃ sādhakatamam| yasmin satyavilambanena (kāryaṃ) jñānamutpadyate tadatiśayitamityucyate| tena pramākaraṇaṃ pramāṇamiti siddham| dharmarājādhvarīndrakṛtapramālakṣaṇakhaṇḍanam anadhigatārthagantṛ pramāṇamityādikaṃ tu tattadvādibhireva nirastatvādanādaraṇīyam| viśiṣṭādvaitābhimatapramāṇasaṃkhyā tāni pramāṇāni pratyakṣānumānaśabdākhyāni trīṇyeva| pratyakṣapramāṇalakṣaṇam tatra sākṣātkāripramākaraṇaṃ pratyakṣam| anumānādivyāvṛttyarthaṃ sākṣātkārīti| dṛṣṭendriyajanyavyāvṛttyarthaṃ prameti| pratyakṣasya nirvikalpakaṃ savikalpakamiti bhedadvayanirūpaṇam tacca pratyakṣaṃ dvividhaṃ - nirvikalpakasavikalpakabhedāt| nirvikalpakaṃ nāma guṇasaṃsthānādiviśiṣṭa prathamapiṇḍagrahaṇam| savikalpakaṃ tu sapratyavamarśaṃ guṇasaṃsthānādiviśiṣṭadvitīyādipiṇḍagrahaṇam| ubhayamapyetadviśiṣṭa viṣayameva| aviśiṣṭagrāgiṇo jñānasyānupalambhādanupapatteśca| vastūnāṃ grahaṇaprakāraḥ grahaṇaprakārastu - ātmā manasā saṃyujyate, mana indriyeṇa, indriyamarthena| indriyāṇāṃ prāpya prakāśakāritvaniyamāt|ato ghaṭādirūpārthasya cakṣurādī(cakṣūrūpe)ndriyasya ca sannikarṣe sati ayaṃ ghaṭaḥ paṭa iti cākṣūṣajñānaṃ jāyate| evaṃ spārśanapratyakṣādayo'pi| sambandhavicāraḥ dravyagrahaṇe saṃyogassambandhaḥ| dravyagatarūpādigrahaṇe samavāyānaṅgīkārāt saṃyuktāśrayaṇaṃ sambandhaḥ| pratyakṣasyāvāntarabhedāḥ nirvikalpakasavikalpakabhinnaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dvividham - arvācīnamanarvācīnaṃ ceti| arvācīnaṃ punardvividham - indriyasāpekṣaṃ tadanapekṣaṃ ceti| tadanapekṣaṃ dvividham - svayaṃsiddhaṃ divyaṃ ceti| svayaṃsiddhaṃ - yogajanyam, divyaṃ bhagavatprasādajanyam| anarvācīnaṃ tu, indriyānapekṣaṃ nityamukteścarajñānam| anarvācīnaṃ prasaṅgāduktam| evaṃ sākṣātkāripramākaraṇaṃ pratyakṣamiti siddham| smṛteḥ pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ nanu yathāvasthitavyavahārānuguṇaṃ jñānaṃ prametyuktam, evañca smṛterapi yathāvasthitavyavahārānuguṇajñānatvena prāmāṇyāt smṛterapi pramāṇatvena parigaṇanācca trīṇyeva pramāṇānīti kathaṃ pratipādyata iti cet; ucyate smṛteḥ prāmāṇyāṅgīkāre'pi saṃskārasāpekṣatvāttasyāḥ pratyakṣamūlatvānmūlabhūte pratyakṣe'ntarbhāva iti na pṛthakpramāṇatvakalpanam| ataḥ pramāṇāni trīṇyeveti sambhavati| smṛtinirūpaṇam smṛtirnāma pūrvānubhavajanyasaṃskāramātrajanyaṃ jñānam| tatra codbuddhassaṃskāro hetuḥ| saṃskārodbodhaśca sadṛśādṛṣṭacintādyāḥ smṛtibījasya bodhakāḥ, ityuktaprakāreṇa kvacitsadṛśadarśanādbhavati, kvacidadṛṣṭāt, kvaciccintayā| ādiśabdena sāhacaryasyāpi grahaṇāt tenāpi bhavati| sādṛśyajā yathā - devadattayajñadattayossadṛśayordevadattadarśanena yajñadattasmṛtiḥ| dvitīyā yathā - yādṛcchikakālāntaradeśāntarānubhūtaśrīraṅgādidivyadeśasmṛtiḥ| tṛtīyā yathā - cintyamāne sati śrīveṅkaṭeśasya kamanīyadivyamaṅgalavigrahasmṛtiḥ| caturthī tu - sahacaritayordevadattayajñadatyayormadhye'nyataradarśanena tadanyatarasmṛtiḥ| samyaganubhūtasya sarvasya smṛtiviṣayatvaniyamaḥ| kvacitkāladairghyāt vyādhyādinā vā saṃskārasya pramoṣāt smṛtyabhāvaḥ| pratyakṣabhijñādīnāṃ pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaprakāraḥ yathā smṛteḥ pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ, evaṃ so'yaṃ devadatta iti pratyabhijñāyā api pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ| asmanmate abhāvasya bhāvāntararūpatvāt tajjñānasyāpi pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ| bhūtale ghaṭātyantābhāvo bhūtalameva| ghaṭaprāgabhāvo nāma mṛdeva| ghaṭadhvaṃsaśca kapālameva| prāyaḥ purūṣeṇānena bhavitavyamityetadūhaḥ| puraḥ kiṃsaṃjñako'yaṃ vṛkṣa ityanadhyavasāyo jñānaṃ saṃśaya uktaḥ| etayorapi pratyakṣe'ntarbhāvaḥ| puṇyapuruṣaniṣṭhā pratibhā'pi pratyakṣe'ntargatā| yathārthakhyāteḥ samarthanam yathārtha sarvavijñānamiti vedavidaṃ matam ityuktatvāt bhramādipratyakṣādi jñānaṃ yathārthameva| akhyātyātmakhyātyanirvacanīyakhyātyanyathākhyātyasatkhyātivādino nirasya satkhyātipakṣasvīkārāt| satkhyātirnāma jñānaviṣayasya satyatvam| tarhi bhramatvaṃ kathamiti cet, viṣayavyavahārabādhād bhramatvam| tadupapādayāmaḥ| pañcīkaraṇaprakriyayā pṛthivyādiṣu sarvatra sarvabhūtānāṃ vidyamānatvājjñānaviṣayasya satyatvam| tatra rajatāṃśabhūyastvajñānāt bhramanivṛttiḥ| svapnādijñānaṃ tu satyameva| tattatpurūṣānubhāvyatayā tattatkālāvasānān rathādīn paramapuruṣaḥ sṛjatīti hi śrutyā'vagamyate| pītaśśaṅkha ityādau nayanavartipittadravyasambhinnā nāyanaraśmayaśśaṅkhādibhissaṃyujyante| tatra pittagatapītimābhibhūtaḥ śaṅkhagataśuklimā na gṛhyate| atassuvarṇānuliptaśaṅkhavatpītaśśaṅkha iti pratīyate| sūkṣmatvātpītimā svanayananiṣkrāntatayā svenaiva gṛhyate| na tvanyaiḥ|japākusumasamīpavartisphaṭikamaṇirapi rakta iti gṛhyate| tajjñānaṃ satyameva| marīcikāyāṃ jalajñānamapi pañcīkaraṇaprakriyayā pūrvoktavadupapadyate| pañcī karaṇaprakriyā tūttaratra vakṣyate| digbhramo'pi tathaiva| diśi digantarasya vidyamānatvāt, avacchedakamantareṇa digiti dravyāntarānaṅgīkārācca| alātacakrādau tu atiśaighryāt tadantarālāgrahaṇāttattaddeśasaṃyuktatattadvastuna eva cakrākāreṇa grahaṇam| tadapi satyameva| darpaṇādiṣu nijamukhādipratītirapiyathārthā| darpaṇādipratihatagatayo nāyanaraśmayo darpaṇādigrahaṇapūrvakaṃ nijamukhādi gṛhṇanti| tatrāpyatiśaighryādantarālāgrahaṇāttathā pratītiḥ| dvicandra jñānādāvapyaṅgulyavaṣṭambhatimirādibhirnāyanatejogatibhedena sāmagrībhedāt sāmagrīdvayamanyonyanirapekṣaṃ dvicandragahaṇaheturbhavati| sāmagrīdvayaṃ pāramārthikam| tena dvicandrajñānaṃ bhavati |ataḥ sarvaṃ vijñānaṃ satyaṃ saviśeṣaviṣayañca| nirviśeṣavastuno'grahaṇāt| prathamapratyakṣeṇāpi bhedaviśiṣṭasyaiva vastuno grahaṇam| evambhūtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ prathamato (jātyādirūpa) bhedaviśiṣṭameva gṛhṇāti| bheda iti vyavahāre tu pratiyogyapekṣā, na tu svarūpe(ṇa) | tenānavasthā'nyonyāśrayadoṣo'pi nāsti| uparyuparyapekṣā'navasthā| parasparāpekṣā daśamastvamasīti vākyajanyajñānasya pratyakṣatvanirāsaḥ nanu, daśamastvamasītyetadapi pratyakṣaṃ kiṃ na syāditi cenna| tvamityetasya pratyakṣatve'pi daśamo'sītyetasya vākyajanyatvāt| yadi daśamo'sītyasya (pratyakṣatvaṃ) pratyakṣaviṣayatvaṃ tarhi dharmavāṃstvamasītyetasyāpi pratyakṣatvaṃ syāt| aṅgīkāre'piprasaṅgāt| ata eva tattvamasīti vākyasya nāparokṣajñānajanakatvam| pratyakṣaviṣaye'dvaitināṃ naiyāyikānāñca matakhaṇḍanam etena - pratyakṣapramākaraṇaṃ pratyakṣapramāṇam| pramā (cātma) cātra caitanyameva| caitanyañca trividham - antaḥ karaṇāvacchinnacaitanyaṃ , vṛttyavacchinna caitanyaṃ, viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyaṃ ceti| yadā trayāṇāmaikyaṃ tadā sākṣātkāraḥ| tadapi nirviśeṣaviṣayameva, abhedameva gṛhṇātītyādikudṛṣṭikalpanā nirastā| nirvikalpakaṃ tu nāmajātyādiyojanāhīnaṃ vastumātrāvagāhi kiñcididamiti jñānamiti naiyāyikānāṃ matamapi nirastam| naiyāyikānāṃ bahiṣkārapakṣaḥ nanu ‘kāṇādaṃ pāṇinīyaṃ ca sarvaśāstropakārakam' ityuktatvāt kathaṃ gautamamatanirāsa iti cet, ucyate; na khalu (nāsmābhiḥ) kārtsnye nāsya matasya nirāsaḥ kriyate| yāvadiha yuktiyuktaṃ tāvatsvīkriyate, parakalpitataṭākopajīvanavat| na khalu taṭākasthapaṅko'pi svīkriyate| ataḥ paramāṇukāraṇatvam, vedapaurūṣeyatvam, īśvarānumānikatvam, jīvavibhutvam, sāmānyaviśeṣaṇasamavāyānāṃ padārthatvena svīkāraḥ, upamānādeḥ pṛthak pramāṇatvakalpanam, saṅkhyāparimāṇapṛthaktvavibhāgaparatvāparatvagurūtvadravatvādīnāṃ pṛthagguṇatvalpanam, diśo'pi dravyatvakalpanamityādisūtrakārādivirūddhaprakriyā nāsmābhiḥ svīkriyate| avirūddhāni tu svīkriyanta iti na virodhaḥ| iti śrīvādhūlakulatilakaśrīmanmahācāryaprathamadāsena śrīnivāsadāsena viracitāyāṃ yatīndramatadīpikāyāṃ śarīrakaparibhāṣāyāṃ pratyakṣanirūpaṇaṃ nāma prathamo'vatāraḥ|| atha dvitīyo'vatāraḥ anumānalakṣaṇam anumiti lakṣaṇañca athānumānaṃ nirūpyate| vyāpyatvānusandhānāt vyāpakaviśeṣapramitiranumitiḥ| tatkaraṇamanumānam|tatkaraṇamanumānam| vyāpyasya - dhūmasya, agnivyāpyatvānusandhānāt vyāpakaviśeṣapramitirvahnipramitiḥ| vyāptinirūpaṇam anadhikadeśakālaniyamaṃ (taṃ) vyāpyam| anyūnadeśakālavṛtti vyāpakam| tadidamavinābhūtaṃ vyāpyam, tatpratisambandhi vyāpakamiti| tena nirūpādhikatayā niyatasambandho vyāptirityuktaṃ bhavati| seyaṃ yatra dhūmastatra vahni riti vyāptirbhūyodarśanena gṛhyate| vyāptirdvidhā - anvayavyatirekabhedāt| sādhanavidhau sādhyavidhirūpeṇa pravṛttā vyāptiranvayavyāptiḥ|yathā - yo yo dhūmavān sa so'gnimāniti| sādhyaniṣedhe sādhananiṣedharūpeṇa pravṛttā vyāptirvyatirekavyāptiḥ| yathā - yo'nagniḥ sa nirdhūma iti| seyamubhaya vidhā vyāptirūpādhisambhave duṣṭā| upādhinirūpaṇam sādhyavyāpakatve sati sādhanāvyāpakatvamupādhiḥ| yathā - vahninā dhūme sādhyamāne ārdrendhanasaṃyoga upādhiḥ| maitrītanayatvena śyāmatve sādhyamāne śākapākajatvamupādhiḥ| sa copādhirdvividhaḥ - niścitaḥ śaṅkitaśceti| niścito yathā - vipratipannā sevā duḥkhahetuḥ, sevātvāt, rājasevāvāt ityatra pāpārabdhatvamupādhiḥ| ayaṃ ceśvarasevāyāṃ nāstīti niścayādayaṃ niścitopādhiḥ| śaṅkito yathā - vipratipanno jīva etaccharīrāvasāne muktimān, niṣpannasamādhitvāt, śukādivadityatra karmātyantaparikṣaya upādhiḥ| sa ca niṣpannasamādhau vipratipanne jīve asti (vā) nāstīti sandigdhatvāvacchaṅkitopādhiḥ| ato nirūpādhikasambandhavadvyāpyamiti siddham| vyāpyanirūpaṇam vyāpyaṃ sādhanam, liṅgamityanarthāntaram| tasya dve rūpe - anumityaṅgabhūte vyāptiḥ pakṣadharmatā ceti| pañca rūpāṇyapi santi, tāni ca - pakṣa (vyāpakatvam) dharmatvama, (sattvam), sapakṣe sattvam vipakṣādvyavṛttiḥ, abādhitaviṣayatvam, asatpratipakṣatvaṃ ceti| siṣādhayiṣitadharmaviśiṣṭo dharmo pakṣaḥ| yathā - agnimattvādisādhane parvatādiḥ| siṣādhayiṣitadharmasajātīyadharmavān sapakṣaḥ| yathā - mahānasādiḥ| sādhyatajjātīyaśūnyo vipakṣaḥ| yathā - mahāhradādiḥ| prabalapramāṇena pakṣe niścitasādhyābhāvavattvaṃ bādhitaviṣayatvam| yathā - mahāhrado agnimānityādiḥ| tadabhāvavattvamabhādhita viṣayatvam| samabalatayā pratīyamānapramāṇoparodhābhāvo'satpratipakṣatvam| vyāpyabhedau evambhūtaṃ vyāpyaṃ dvividham - anvayavyatirekikevalānvayibhedāt| pūrvoktapañcarūpopapannaṃ vyāpyamanvayavyatireki| yathā - parvato'gnimān dhūmavattvāt, yo yo dhūmavān sa so'gnimān, yathā - mahānasaḥ| yo'nagnissa nirdhūmaḥ, yathā - hrada iti| tādṛśameva vipakṣarahitaṃ vyāpyaṃ kevalānvayi| yathā - brahmaśabdavācyaṃ vastutvāt, ghaṭavat| vipakṣābhāvāt kevalānvayi catūrūpopannam| kevalavyatirekiṇi sādhyaprasiddheḥ tadvyatirekavyāptirdurgrahā| ataḥ kevalavyatirekinirāsaḥ| kevalānvayini anvayavyatirekiṇi cātyantātīndriyārthagocaratā nirastā| anumānasya bhedadvayam tadetadanumānaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ceti dvidhā vibhajya kecidāhuḥ| sarveṣāmevānumānānāṃ svapratisandhānādibalena pravṛttatayā svavyavahāramātrahetutvamiti svārthānumānamevetyapare| anumānasyāvayavapañcakam tadetadanumānaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ceti dvidhā vibhajya kecidāhuḥ| sarveṣāmevānumānānāṃ svapratisandhānādibalena pravṛttatayā
